When a part contains multiple approved core instances, this check only proves that `alternative_to` names one of them, while the later `any(...)` family comparison can be satisfied by a different core. A candidate support can therefore reference an approved core from its own family and still pass the candidate-only foreign-support custody boundary because another unrelated core has a different family. Resolve the referenced core and compare the support family directly against that core.
